steps.name: Step 0 (setup) — create the 'normalized_issue'/'kb_results'/'triage_summary' custom state variables via the STATE panel, so they're selectable in the Agent node's Input/Output combos later
Step 5 — Click "Add node" -> "Agent"; a fresh Agent node appears
Step 6 — Static config fields present immediately (before any Agent is selected); INPUT MAPPING is absent, and NO Structured output toggle exists for this node type
Step 7 (case steps 2, 3, 7) — Attach the agent: the TOOLS "+ Agent" button was removed (EL-7159); open the Agent node's "Agents & Pipelines" picker and select the fixture agent
Step 4 — Verify the agent appears attached in TOOLS as a flat-list card (no 'sub-tab' — same root cause as EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public#1149/#530)
